items.title: NASA’s Voyager 1 Makes History Reaching One Light-Day From Earth
items.abstract: NASA’s Voyager 1 probe, humanity’s farthest-flying spacecraft, has reached one light-day from Earth, after more than 49 years of constant travel. A light-day is the distance light travels in 24 hours, equaling about 16.1 billion miles (25.9 billion kilometers). The spacecraft achieved the milestone...

items.title: Exquisite X-rays and dynamic compression initiate a new era of physics experiments on plutonium
items.abstract: Scientists at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL), Argonne National Laboratory (ANL) and Washington State University (WSU) have conducted the first dynamic compression experiments on plutonium at a national light source facility, the Dynamic Compression Sector (DCS).
